h4_frontier_rule.question: how much forecasting accuracy survives a given reduction in inference cost?
h4_frontier_rule.operating_point: per model x dataset x arm x budget eps: the SHALLOWEST block depth l < L whose VALIDATION MASE ratio to the full native model is <= 1 + eps at EVERY truncation depth j in [l, L-1] (sustained, the Phase-1 operator)
h4_frontier_rule.fallback: no qualifying depth -> no truncation: the full native model (speedup 1)
h4_frontier_rule.selection_data: validation only; the selected depth is frozen, then test is read once
h4_frontier_rule.entrance_test: the frozen Phase-1 entrance test (H4_OUTCOME_RULE) is kept unchanged as the stricter secondary hypothesis test

h4_rule.candidate_depth: the frozen Phase-1 sustained tunnel entrance at tol 0.05
h4_rule.decision_metric: test MASE ratio vs the full native model minus 1 (point estimate)
h4_rule.on_failure: report the failure; never search for, evaluate or substitute another depth
h4_rule.fragile: the paired 95% cluster-bootstrap CI of the decision metric contains the budget

provenance: rebuilt by experiments.make_phase2_tables from saved artifacts only
